info.name: THOB API
info.description:
THOB B2B fabric marketplace API — completed phases only (0, 1, 2, 4, 5, 6).

Base URL, phones, and IDs come from the **THOB — Local** environment. Import both files.

## Auth
Collection-level auth adds `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}` to every request (public
requests override it to `noauth`). Run **Phase 0 → OTP request → OTP verify → Register**
(or **Login**) once: the test scripts write `{{token}}` for you.

## Not included
Phase 3 Catalog product CRUD (`POST/PATCH/DELETE /products*`, `/admin/products*`) — the
phase is not implemented. Search reads product data, so the Search folder works against
seeded/factory products.

See `docs/API_REFERENCE.md` for full contracts and the `custom_code` registry, and
`docs/postman/README.md` for the token flow.

exec: // Collection-wide sanity checks on the THOB envelope.

item.name: Phase 0 — Auth
item.description: US-ACC-01 (register + OTP), US-ACC-02 (account type), US-ACC-07 (login/logout/recovery), SEC-NFR-02. All requests here are public except `me`, `logout`, `account-type`.

request.description:
US-ACC-01 · public · Sends a 6-digit OTP (hashed at rest, never returned). Throttled 3/min per phone (429/4290). `purpose=registration` for a new phone; an existing phone → 409/4091. `purpose=password_reset` for an unknown phone → 200 with empty body (enumeration-safe).

**Dev note:** the `log` OTP driver does not emit the code. Set `{{otp_code}}` manually (see RUNBOOK §3) before running *OTP verify*.

response.name: 200 — code sent
response.body:
{
  "custom_code": 2000,
  "status": true,
  "message": "A verification code has been sent.",
  "body": {},
  "info": "from response action"
}

response.name: 409 — phone already registered
response.body:
{
  "custom_code": 4091,
  "status": false,
  "message": "This phone number is already registered. Please log in.",
  "body": { "phone": ["This phone number is already registered. Please log in."] },
  "info": "from ApiException response"
}

request.description: US-ACC-01 · public · Verifies the OTP. Throttled 5/min per phone. 3 wrong codes lock the request (422/4221). On success returns `body.registration_token` **or** `body.reset_token` (per `purpose`); the test script saves it to the environment.

US-ACC-01, BR-ACC-01 · public · Creates the account from a valid `registration_token`. Bad/expired token → 422/4224. Phone already a user → 409/4091. Email optional, unique when given. Returns **HTTP 201** with the Sanctum bearer `body.token` (saved by the test script) and `next_onboarding_step: account_type_selection`.

US-ACC-07 · public · Phone + password → bearer token. Throttled 5/min per phone+IP (429/4290). Wrong phone **or** password → 422/4222 (`body.phone`, generic message — no user enumeration). Returns `body.next_onboarding_step` (`account_type_selection` | `business_profile` | `none`).
US-ACC-07 · public · Requires a `reset_token` from *OTP verify* with `purpose=password_reset`. Bad/expired token → 422/4224. On success **all** the user's bearer tokens are revoked.
US-ACC-02 · public · Lists the 4 account types with bilingual `label`/`description` (follows `Accept-Language`) and `requires_business_profile` (false only for `customer`).
US-ACC-07 · `auth:sanctum` · Current user: `id, phone, email, account_type, status, language`.

US-ACC-02, BR-ACC-02 · `auth:sanctum` · One-time choice; sets `status = active`. Already chosen → 409/4092. Use `wholesaler`/`retailer` to act as a buyer in later folders; `importer` to act as a seller.
US-ACC-07 · `auth:sanctum` · Revokes the current access token only.

item.name: Phase 1 — Business Profile / Verification / Audit
item.description: US-ACC-03/04/05, US-ADM-01, US-ADM-09, SEC-NFR-01/03/05. Business endpoints need a `wholesaler`/`retailer`/`importer` token; admin endpoints need an `admin` role token (`{{token_admin}}`).

request.description: US-ACC-03, BR-ACC-03 · `auth:sanctum`, importer/wholesaler/retailer, no profile yet · Creates the profile in `unverified` status. `governorate_id` must exist in `/taxonomy/governorates`. Customer → 422 `body.account_type`. Second profile → 422 `body.user_id`. Returns **HTTP 201**.

response.name: 201 — created
response.body:
{
  "custom_code": 2000,
  "status": true,
  "message": "Business profile created.",
  "body": {
    "business": {
      "id": 1,
      "company_name": "Nile Textiles Co.",
      "activity": "Cotton fabric import",
      "governorate_id": 1,
      "verified": false,
      "address": "12 El-Geish St, Cairo",
      "contact_person": "Sara Ahmed",
      "contact_channels": [{ "type": "whatsapp", "value": "+201000000002" }],
      "verification_status": "unverified",
      "onboarded_by_admin": false,
      "created_at": "2026-09-06T12:00:00.000000Z",
      "updated_at": "2026-09-06T12:00:00.000000Z"
    }
  },
  "info": "from response action"
}

request.description: US-ACC-03/05 · `auth:sanctum` · No authorize gate — any authed user reads the **public subset** (`id, company_name, activity, governorate_id, verified`). Owner/admin additionally see address, contact person, contact channels, verification status, timestamps.
US-ACC-03 · `auth:sanctum`, owner or admin (else native 403) · Partial update; every scalar field is `sometimes`.

formdata.description: PDF/JPG/PNG per config verification.accepted_mimes; size ≤ verification.max_file_size_kb

request.description: US-ACC-04, SEC-NFR-05 · `auth:sanctum`, owner, business not yet verified (else native 403) · Validates extension **and** MIME **and** size. Stored on the private `verification` disk. Response `body.document.download_url` is a temporary **signed** URL (saved to `{{download_url}}`).

US-ACC-04, SEC-NFR-01 · `auth:sanctum` + `signed` · Paste-through of the `download_url` returned by *Upload*. Streams the raw file. Bad/absent signature → 403; wrong business for the document → 404. (The signature already encodes auth context; keep the bearer header too when testing as the owner.)
US-ACC-04 · `auth:sanctum`, owner only (admin cannot) · No body. Zero documents → 422 `body.documents`. On success business → `Pending`, event `VerificationSubmitted`.
US-ACC-04/05 · `auth:sanctum`, owner or admin · `verification_status`, `verified`, `rejection_reason`, `reviewed_at`, `documents[]`.
US-ADM-01 · `auth:sanctum`, **admin** · Paginated queue of pending + submitted requests, newest first. Non-admin → 403.
US-ADM-01, US-ADM-09, BR-ADM-01 · **admin** · No body. Request not pending/submitted → 409/4092. On success: business → `Verified`, audit row `verification.approved`, event `VerificationApproved`.

US-ADM-01, US-ADM-09, BR-ADM-01 · **admin** · `reason` required (3–1000 chars) → else 400 `body.reason`. On success: business → `Rejected`, audit row `verification.rejected`, event `VerificationRejected`. Owner may then re-upload.

item.name: Phase 2 — Subscriptions
item.description: US-SUB-01..08, BR-SUB-01/02/03, SEC-NFR-04. Needs a token for a user who owns a business profile. NOTE: `POST`/`PATCH /subscriptions` return **Laravel-native 422** `{message,errors}` on validation error, not the envelope (discrepancy D5).

request.description: US-SUB-01/02 · `auth:sanctum` · Active plans (optionally filtered by account type), each with its `entitlements: [{key,value}]`. `price` may be null.

US-SUB-05/07, BR-SUB-01 · `auth:sanctum`, must own a business profile (else native 403) · Existing active subscription → 409/4091. Plan's `account_type` ≠ caller's → 422/4222. Pass `trial_ends_at` (future date) for a no-payment trial. Returns **HTTP 201**.
US-SUB-04 · `auth:sanctum`, owner or admin (else **403/4031**) · Plan + entitlements (as `{key:value}`), status, period end, trial state.
US-SUB-04 · owner or admin · `usage: { <entitlement_key>: { limit, current } }` + renewal date. `current` is null for non-counter entitlements. (No billing history — depends on Payments, R4.)

US-SUB-05, BR-SUB-02 · owner or admin (else 403/4031) · `action` = `upgrade` | `downgrade` | `cancel`; `plan_id` required for upgrade/downgrade. Non-active subscription → 422/4221.

- **upgrade** → old row cancelled, new active row on the target plan (immediate).
- **downgrade** → `notes.pending_plan_id` set; current row untouched until period end.
- **cancel** → `notes.cancel_at_period_end = true`; current row untouched.

Deferred actions apply via `php artisan subscriptions:process-period-ends`.

item.name: Phase 3 — Catalog (seller products + media + CSV import)
item.description: US-SEL-01..08, US-SEL-11, BR-SEL-01/03/04. auth:sanctum, importer/retailer. Bulk import (3.3) is not built (#16). Run in order: Create product -> Upload product image -> Publish product.

request.description: US-SEL-02 - the owner's catalog, all statuses, paginated.

exec: const v = (pm.response.json().body || {}).product && pm.response.json().body.product.id; if (v) pm.environment.set("product_id", v);

request.description: US-SEL-01, BR-SEL-01/03 - creates in draft (review off) or pending_review (review on); never straight to published. Enforces product_limit and price XOR. -> 201, {{product_id}} saved.
US-SEL-05 - owner only. Partial; re-syncs colors/price_tiers when present.
US-SEL-09 - seller. CSV template: header row + one worked example, UTF-8 BOM. Compound columns: color_ids "3;7", price_tiers "50:41.00;200:38.50", price_on_contact "1"/"0".

exec: const v = (pm.response.json().body || {}).import && pm.response.json().body.import.id; if (v) pm.environment.set("import_batch_id", v);

formdata.description: CSV only (mimes:csv,txt), <= 2 MB. Use the downloaded template.

request.description: US-SEL-09/US-SEL-10, BR-SEL-01/02/03 - importer/retailer (not wholesaler/customer). Stashes the file, dispatches a queued job, returns 202 body.import.id ({{import_batch_id}} saved). Each valid row -> a pending_review product; a bad row is failed and skipped; rows past product_limit are limit_rejected.
US-SEL-09 - batch owner only (else 403). Batch status + per-row report: body.import.rows[] = { row_number, status: imported|failed|limit_rejected, product_id, errors }.

exec: const v = (pm.response.json().body || {}).media && pm.response.json().body.media.id; if (v) pm.environment.set("media_id", v);

request.description: US-SEL-03 - owner only. One image; validated by extension + MIME + size; stored on the public disk. Cap 10/product -> 422. -> 201, {{media_id}} saved.
US-SEL-03 - owner only. Body is the FULL ordered id list; index 0 is the cover. Partial/foreign list -> 422.
US-SEL-03 - owner only. Removes the file from the disk and the row. Wrong product for the media id -> 404.
US-SEL-07 - owner only. status in hidden|unavailable|published|pending_review. Publishing runs the gate: >=1 image + price XOR -> else 422. With review on, published lands in pending_review.
US-SEL-07 - owner only. Copies as a draft; increments product_count. -> 201.
US-SEL-07 - owner only. Soft delete (BR-SEL-04); decrements product_count.
US-SEL-11 - admin. Pending-review queue.
US-SEL-11, BR-ADM-01 - admin. pending_review -> published; 422 if the product has no image. Audit product.approved.
US-SEL-11, BR-ADM-01 - admin. -> rejected + reason. Audit product.rejected.

item.name: Phase 4 — Search
item.description: US-SRC-01..11, BR-SRC-01/02. All public (`optional.sanctum`). Reads Catalog product data (**Partial / Phase 3 Pending** — seed/factory products only).

request.description: US-SRC-01/02/03/04/10, BR-SRC-01/02 · public · Paginated buyer-visible products. Featured items get a within-page boost (relevance/newest) and `featured: true`. Zero-result terms are logged to `search_logs`.

response.name: 200 — results

request.description: US-SRC-05 · public · Full spec + `price_tiers[]` + `media[]` + supplier identity/badge + `actions.contact` / `actions.request_quotation`. A non-buyer-visible product returns **404** (never 403). Internal fields (`status`, `rejection_reason`) are omitted.
US-SRC-07, US-SRC-10 · public · Business accounts only (customers never appear); suspended-owner suppliers excluded. Featured suppliers boosted + `featured: true`.
US-SRC-06 · public · Same filter/sort/pagination contract as *Search products*, scoped to one business. No zero-result logging.

item.name: Phase 5 — Favorites / Comparison
item.description: US-SRC-08/09, US-BUY-02/05, BR-FAV-01, BR-CMP-01. All `auth:sanctum`. Operate on product ids (from the Search folder) and supplier ids.

exec: pm.test('201 first time / 200 if already saved', () =>

request.description: US-SRC-08, BR-FAV-01 · `auth:sanctum` · `type` = `product` | `supplier`. First save → **201**; saving the same item again → **200** (idempotent, same row). Missing/non-visible target → **404** (`custom_code 4040`).
US-SRC-08, US-BUY-02 · `auth:sanctum` · Self-scoped, newest first, paginated. Each entry's `item` is the matching search card.
US-SRC-08 · `auth:sanctum`, owner only (else 403) · Deletes by favorite id (no toggle-by-target endpoint).

query.description: up to 4, comma-separated or ids[]; de-duplicated

request.description: US-SRC-09, US-BUY-05, BR-CMP-01 · `auth:sanctum` · On-demand, no storage. A 5th id → **400** with a message naming the limit "4". Unknown / non-visible ids come back in `missing_ids`. Products → detail shape; suppliers → card shape.

item.name: Phase 6 — Inquiries / RFQ / Quotation / Reporting
item.description: US-INQ-01..09, US-ANL-03, BR-INQ-01/02. All `auth:sanctum`. Buyer actions need a `wholesaler`/`retailer` token (`{{token_buyer}}`); seller actions need the addressed business's owner token (`{{token_seller}}`).

request.description: US-INQ-01, BR-INQ-01/02 · `auth:sanctum`, wholesaler/retailer (else 403) · Provide `product_id` and/or `seller_business_id` (at least one). Rate-limited per user (429/4290). Seller past `inquiry_limit` → 422/4231 (`body.inquiry_limit`). Creates a Lead in `new` status. **HTTP 201**.

response.name: 201 — inquiry sent
422 — seller inquiry limit reached
response.body:
{
  "custom_code": 4231,
  "status": false,
  "message": "This supplier is not accepting new inquiries right now.",
  "body": { "inquiry_limit": ["This supplier is not accepting new inquiries right now."] },
  "info": "from ApiException response"
}

request.description: US-INQ-06/07, US-ANL-03 · `auth:sanctum` · The Lead Management screen. `role=seller` → the caller's business's leads (empty if no business profile); `role=buyer` → the caller's sent inquiries. There is no separate `/businesses/{id}/leads` route.
US-INQ-01 · `auth:sanctum`, party to the inquiry (else 403).

US-INQ-07 · `auth:sanctum`, **the seller only** (else 403) · `lead_status` ∈ {new, in_progress, done, not_completed}. Spec §11 names this `PATCH /inquiries/{id}/status`; the implemented path has no `/status` segment.

US-INQ-02 · `auth:sanctum`, the inquiry's buyer (else 403) · `product_id` must belong to the inquiry's seller. `needed_by_date` must be today or later. Quantity below the product MOQ → `below_moq: true` (a warning, still **201**). Shares the rate-limit + `inquiry_limit` re-check with *Send inquiry* (no re-increment). Spec §11 names this `.../rfq` (singular).
US-INQ-02/03 · `auth:sanctum`, party to the RFQ (else 403) · Quotations inlined; each carries `expired` computed from `valid_until`.
US-INQ-03 · `auth:sanctum`, **the RFQ's addressed seller only** (else 403) · `valid_until` must be in the future. Event `QuotationReceived`. **HTTP 201**.
US-INQ-09 · `auth:sanctum`, either party to the inquiry (else 403) · Durable record only — no moderation workflow / admin queue yet (Phase 9). **HTTP 201**.
